parsed.why: Criminalisation (2019) was repealed in 2020 and not re-enacted. Exposure is occasional modesty-charge misuse and common individual harassment, with no documented state targeting of visitors. Thin border data and no recognition regime are resident-facing. Constitutional marriage bar is not a traveller exposure.

Active 2024 law: 10-15 years for same-sex relations, 1-3 years for gender-affirming care and gender expression, with deportation. Documented killings, state complicity via neglect, and impunity. Trans-specific targeting is state-backed; no protective operating machinery.

No trans-specific offence; hate-crime law covers gender identity; self-declaration gender recognition; conversion-therapy ban; liberal social climate. Documented hostility is concentrated and under-reported, with a falling but present threat level. Healthcare access restrictions are resident-facing.

Not criminalised; constitutional and statutory anti-discrimination; administrative gender-marker change without surgery. Enforcement is weak: ombudsman found no sentences for LGBT murders, and survey reports widespread exclusion. Single-year data is dated.

Penal Code sodomy offence up to 20 years plus whipping applies to tourists. Religious cross-dressing bans in all states; state-directed targeting; 208-man sauna raid in 2025; a 2019 killing with impunity. Active, enforced state hostility is documented.
